title: Mass inequality |Y(ω)| ≤ C·M(Y) under a pointwise bound |ω| ≤ C
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, let Y ∈ D_n(U) (a GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) (a TestFormOn U n, i.e. a smooth compactly supported n-form on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ U), and let C ∈ ℝ with C > 0 and |ω(x)| ≤ C for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2} is Simon's Euclidean coefficient norm. Assume the mass M(Y) = Y.mass = M_U(Y) is finite. Then |Y(ω)| ≤ C·M(Y), where M(Y) ∈ [0, ∞) is read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → (∀ x : Eucl P, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C) → Y.mass ≠ ∞ → |Y ω| ≤ C * Y.mass.toReal
